title: cyclind: Cyclical Composite Indicators: Leading, Coincident and Lagging
description: R package that builds cyclical composite indicators for business and growth cycles (composite leading indicators, CLI, and coincident indices) following the OECD system of composite leading indicators. Candidate series are de-trended and smoothed, turning points are dated with the Bry-Boschan and Harding-Pagan rules, and every candidate is classified as leading, coincident, lagging or rejected. Leading and coincident components are aggregated into a composite that is re-selected until it passes in-sample and pseudo out-of-sample tests, with a quality scorecard, an audit trail of selection decisions and an optional 'shiny' interface.
